entities.summary: Artur Yurievich Gavrus is a Belarusian ice hockey player. He is currently playing for HC Dinamo Saint Petersburg of the Supreme Hockey League (VHL). He formerly played with HC Dinamo Minsk of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was selected by the New Jersey Devils in the 6th round of the 2012 NHL Entry Draft. He previously played for the Owen Sound Attack of the Ontario Hockey League, a major junior league in Canada.
